Broad marble steps lead up to a wide porch between tall marble
columns.  On this raised platform you can see a large altar, with the
remnants of recent sacrifices.  Through the open doors that tower
above you you can the cool dim recesses of the temple itself.

Exits.Description:
Steps down from the temple lead both south and west, both to busy
streets.
Steps down from the temple lead west to the busy via Rodentia.

Rooms.Name: Temple of Vulcan
Rooms.Description:
Stepping into the cool darkness of the interior temple you are
immediately struck by an enormous statue of the god in all his glory.
So lifelike you are tempted to touch it to see if it is really cool
marble or warm flesh, but the mighty frown on the god makes you
hesitate.

Exits.Description:
The wide space flanked by tall columns lies just to the east, and is
the only exit.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Vulcan is holding an iron hammer in his hands.  He looks prepared to
use it.

Rooms.Name: The Sewers
Rooms.Description:
A disorienting maze of tunnels carry off excess rain water and sewage
and dump them into the Tiber downstream from Rome.  The tunnels are
large enough for all but giants to walk through standing upright, but
only those forced to work or flee down here will be found here.  They
are probably not in a good mood, being here.

Exits.Description: It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.
It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.
It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.
It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.

Rooms.Name: The Sewers
Rooms.Description:
Little light trickles in here.  There are many entrances to the
sewers, but the sewers are vast in size and have many turns and twists,
foiling the light that would illuminate them.  If you failed to bring a
light source with you, you may wander forever in darkness.

Exits.Description: It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.
It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.
It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.

Rooms.Name: The Sewers
Rooms.Description:
It is dark here, and the stench is enough to kill even those with a
cast iron stomach.  What look like glowing eyes in the darkness may
turn out to be just that ... eyes of some unbearable monster.  You are
disoriented, not sure which way to turn.

Exits.Description: It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.
It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.
It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.
It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.

Rooms.Name: The Sewers
Rooms.Description:
Endless twists and turns in the dark, unlit bowels of the city make
you feel lost and confused.  The smell makes you retch.  The walls are
rough brick, damp to the touch.  The floor is rough beneath your feet.

Exits.Description: It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.
It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.
It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.
It is very dark, unlit, and smells bad in all directions.

Rooms.Name: Stairway
Rooms.Description:
Wooden steps lead up to cheaper apartments and down towards the
street.  The steps are dimly lit by window arches cut high up into the
wall.  It would be easy to miss your step here and fall.  An elegant
apartment takes up most of this level, starting east of here.

Exits.Description: A door leads east into an apartment, probably a wealthy one.
The stairs go up.
The stairs go down.

Rooms.Name: Cenaculum
Rooms.Description:
You have stumbled into the children's sleeping quarters in this
large elegant apartment.  From the numbers and variety of toys, you can
tell these are much pampered and well-loved children, well cared-for by
their slaves.  The parents' room is just to the east.
#YA small boy plays quietly here, hoping his parents think he's
sleeping.
#YThe little girl sleeps soundly through her parents' party.#N

Exits.Description: A larger, more furnished room lies to the east.

The apartment entranceway is the atrium, and is immediately south of
here.

Rooms.Name: Cenaculum - Mater and Pater
Rooms.Description:
Beautiful mosaics decorate both walls and floor of this nobleman's
apartment in town.  A bronze chair with a back and arm rests is
evidence of the family's wealth.  The banquet rooms are just east of
here.  The children are to the west, and the entrance room with the
family's shrine is south.

Exits.Description: A large elegant room may be seen through a partially open door.
A large open room lies south of here.
Sounds of children playing come from the room just west of here.

Rooms.Name: Banquets
Rooms.Description:
This is the northern section of a huge area used for entertaining
important guests.  Large platters of food are kept here and circulated
by slaves among the guests.  The room is beautifully furnished with
expensive tables and chairs.  It continues to the south, and there is a
door to the west.

Exits.Description:
The southern half of the room holds three large dining couches and some
low tables.
A small arch-shaped door leads west.

Rooms.Name: Banquet Couches
Rooms.Description:
Three lovely aqua couches sit at right angles to each other, forming
a U shape around a low square table.  Each couch holds 3 diners, and
slaves circulate to serve such delicacies as flamingo tongues and sow's
udders.  You will frequently see a bard or jugglers here, providing
entertainment for the guests.

Exits.Description: The large banquet room extends northward.

A wide archway shows you the apartment's entrance area and family
shrine.

Rooms.Name: Atrium
Rooms.Description:
Murals of country life and bountiful harvests adorn the walls of
this atrium.  Hanging brass oil lamps provide soft lighting during the
evening and at night.  One corner holds the family shrine, dedicated to
the household gods that guard the family's prosperity.

Exits.Description: Through a wide archway you can see living quarters for the family.
Looks (and smells) like a banquet.  The family must be entertaining.

Stairs provide access to the ground floor and the upper level
apartments.

Rooms.Name: Small Apartment
Rooms.Description:
The entrance room of this tiny apartment is predictably small, but
predictably has a small shrine in one corner devoted to the household's
gods.  The bare wood walls of the apartment provide little protection
against the heat of summer or the cold of winter.  The flat's little
bedroom is east of here.

Exits.Description: The small bedroom is just through a louvered door.
A small wooden door leads to the outside world.

Rooms.Name: Small Apartment
Rooms.Description:
The entire family sleeps in this tiny room on straw pallets on the
floor.  There is a small wooden cabinet in one corner used to hold
their few belongings.  There is a small balcony out the door to the
east, and the atrium lies west.

Exits.Description: A large wooden shutter closes off the balcony.
A louvered door separates the atrium from the sleeping quarters.

Rooms.Name: Balcony of a Small Apartment
Rooms.Description:
From here you have an excellent view of via Vestia and the huge
basilica just to the west.  The husband in this small family works in
the courts as a bailiff, keeping the courtrooms peaceful despite some
heated battles.

Rooms.Name: Balcony of a Small Apartment
Rooms.Description:
Tunics, loincloths and other, less identifiable pieces of clothing
have been set out to dry in the sun on this balcony.  You may wish to
stop to admire the view.  From here you can spot the east gate of Rome
and the clay road stretching east.
   #GA stack of laundry sits waiting to be hung out to dry.#N

Exits.Description: The main room (the only room) of this small poor apartment lies west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Sitting in a large straw basket, you can make out a large jumble of
loincloths, tunics and other, less-identifiable pieces of cloth.  They
are all damp, and waiting to be hung out on the balcony to dry in the
hot sunshine.

Rooms.Name: Small Apartment
Rooms.Description:
The successful tutor who lives here recently bought his freedom.  A
Greek who teaches diction to the sons of the mighty, he now lives in
this tiny one room apartment over some shops in eastern Rome.  His
balcony lies to the east, the apartment entrance is west.

Exits.Description: A small balcony is just to the east.

The apartment door is usually kept locked against thieves, of whom
there are many.

Rooms.Name: Apartment Stairs
Rooms.Description:
The stone staircase ends here at two plain wooden doors, each with
doorknob and keyhole.  There are two large potted palms here, and a
small pot with a fern struggling to survive in the hot climate.  The
doors are framed with thick wood, and there is a feeling of poverty
about the landing.  One of the doors has a rather thick lintel over it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Over the top of the doorway, where you can barely see, there seems to be
something hidden, something that glitters.

Rooms.Name: via Phobia
Rooms.Description:
via Phobia continues here in its straight path from Forum to Gate,
past some lovely public gardens.  They look green and cool in the
summer heat, and a bright sunny spot in the winter cold.  The entrance
to the gardens is north.  Just to the south is a small dirty shop
selling captives from foreign lands.

Exits.Description: Green plants and tall palms beckon to you.
A dusty archway leads into a small shop.

Rooms.Name: via Phobia
Rooms.Description:
A well-paved well-swept and well-trodden east-west street intersects
here with a quieter, shadier one that leads north past the public
gardens.  Off to the east you can see the forum, to the west lies the
impressive west gate of Rome, and to the north at some distance lies an
enormous building that you recognize as the racetrack.

Rooms.Name: via Phobia
Rooms.Description:
Strange sounds and smells emanate from the little store north of
here.  The store is unmarked, and fairly dark.  From the lovely mosaics
decorating the door, however, you can tell that the owner is quite
wealthy.  What manner of business could lead to such wealth?  via Phobia
continues in its straight course east and west.

Exits.Description: It's too dark to see anything, really.
A busy intersection near a park ...

You can see the western gate of the city to the west, down this very
straight street.

Rooms.Name: Augurer
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a small office lined with scrolls, many in strange
languages, many quite ancient.  Some you see locked away in a cabinet,
marked "Sibyl".  Others you may examine.  This is the home of one of
the 16 prophets of Rome, a very powerful group of men and not ones to
offend!  They are the augurs.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The augurs examined the sky for flocks of birds, cloud shapes,
lightning and other natural events, omens to tell them the future.

Sibyl was a prophetess who lived in caves in Cumae in early republican
times.

Rooms.Name: Gladiator Training
Rooms.Description:
A very wealthy, very successful gladiator, Mattias has retired from
the arena and opened a school to train men to follow in his footsteps.
His large oak desk sits in a corner.  From the thick dust on it you can
tell he is not often there.  The eastern wall displays a wild assortment
of weapons and various trophies, including his wooden sword and crown
won at great cost in the arena.  Training grounds lie north of here, and
the busy street is back south.

Exits.Description:
The training area begins through the doorway to the north.  You are
welcome to observe, but if you want lessons you will have to pay!
via Phobia is right outside the door.

Rooms.Name: Healer
Rooms.Description:
Although his apprentices assure you he has had much training and
experience as a physician in Rome's glorious battles, nevertheless you
eye the many instruments laid out on the table with fear.  A corner
cabinet is filled with scrolls, and the sweet scent of herbs floats in
through the window.

Exits.Description:
If you decide to remain ill rather than trust your luck with the
physician, the exit to the street is just south of here.

Rooms.Name: Gladiator Training
Rooms.Description:
An assortment of weapons lines one wall of this huge area devoted to
training new gladiators.  You are in a large walled yard, not unlike
the gladiators' arena.  Looking at the weapons and tiny shields, you
wonder if you would survive even the training.

Exits.Description: The training yard stretches off to the west.

Rooms.Name: Gladiator Training
Rooms.Description:
The sand shifts softly beneath your feet, and you avert your eyes
from the darker, slightly sticky patches where trainees have learned a
valuable lesson.  You hope your lesson will be less bloody.  The huge
training arena continues east and west, and the entrance to Mattias'
office is south.

Rooms.Name: Gladiator Training
Rooms.Description:
The training arena is surrounded by a high white wall.  With the
wall to your back, the arena seems to stretch endlessly westward,
filled with desperate men with nothing to lose except their lives.
Great riches and glory may be found in the Colosseum, although the cost
may be quite high.

Exits.Description: The arena continues west.

Rooms.Name: via Phobia
Rooms.Description:
Just north of here lies a famous school for training gladiators.
Becoming a gladiator is a great opportunity for some, and for some
there is no choice.  via Phobia continues both east and west from here.

Exits.Description: Loud clangs and grunts are heard from the open doorway north of here.
Far off in the distance you can spot the Forum.
The west gate of Rome is quite close.

Rooms.Name: West Gate of Rome
Rooms.Description:
The west gate of Rome has been securely locked.  Through the widely
spaced iron bars of the gate you can see the river Tiber flowing
freely.

Exits.Description:
The corner shop of this apartment / shop building looks busy, with 
gladiators and others coming and going in large numbers.
via Phobia runs east and west throughout the heart of the city.

The gate is kept securely locked to prevent undesirables from entering
the city.

Rooms.Name: via Ravena
Rooms.Description:
via Ravena runs north and south, intersecting with via Phobia by the
gardens and via Aggripina to the north.  Just east are some public
gardens which are lovely and soothing to walk through.

Exits.Description: The public gardens offer a peaceful place to rest and relax.
via Ravena intersects with busy via Phobia just south of here.

Rooms.Name: via Ravena
Rooms.Description:
Just east of here you may walk through lovely green gardens, planted
by some benevolent (and ambitious) Roman to show his wealth and his
devotion to the welfare of Rome.  To the north, you will walk by the
west end of a very large building which, from the smell, is probably a
racetrack.

Rooms.Name: via Agrippina
Rooms.Description:
This short street lies between the high northern wall of the city
and the even higher northern wall of Circus Maximus, the city's
racetrack.  Both walls are covered with graffiti, most of which is
devoted to the two racing teams, the Leeks and the Venetians.

Exits.Description:
Horses and chariots are entering a large archway in the wall just east
of here.

Rooms.Name: Outside the West Gate
Rooms.Description:
The river Tiber flows swiftly just west of you, and to the east you
can look through the gates of the western entrance of Rome at the many
splendors of this large city.  A large tunnel is fairly dry at the
moment, but from the odor emanating from it, you know its usual burden
is sewage.

Exits.Description:
Through the iron bars of the gate, the entrancing city of Rome beckons
to you.  Hope you found the key.

Rooms.Name: Public Bathrooms
Rooms.Description:
Public toilets smell much the same all over the world.  You eye
the sponge-on-a-stick with distaste, and think about the clean sweet
smell of the countryside outside of Rome.  The loud clatter of the
street is north of here.

Exits.Description: Through the open door you can see the street.

A large grate covers the service entrance to the sewers.  Only slaves
need go down there.  The smell is enough to kill.

Rooms.Name: Public Gardens
Rooms.Description:
You wander through lush green bushes, under tall palm trees that
thrive in this warm climate.  The gardens are a wonderful place to
rest, relax and think.

Exits.Description: Shaded pathways lead to other parts of the gardens.

When you have finished your lunch (or your rest), you may wish to
wander Rome's busy streets.

When you have finished your lunch (or your rest), you may wish to
wander Rome's busy streets.

Rooms.Name: Public Gardens
Rooms.Description:
Beautiful gardens thrive in the warm climate of Rome.  They are
carefully tended by slaves of the citizen who had gave them to the
city.  Plants are brought in from far distant provinces to add their
beauty and scent to please the Romans.  The gardens continue south of
here, and the quiet street via Ravena is just to the west.

Rooms.Name: Praetor Petyus Enormous Gilded Box at the Racetrack
Rooms.Description:
The Praetor, with some generous "donations" from the Maximus family,
oversaw the building of the enormously popular Circus Maximus racetrack.
There is always a party in his box, although many of the guests are
citizens eager to curry favor, laughing at his jokes.

Exits.Description: Some of the Praetor's best friends are sitting in the seats east.
The Praetor's area continues south.

Rooms.Name: Mob Chute #1
Rooms.Description:
This is mob chute #1 and will only be seen by mobs and imms ... flagged
for no_teleport.  This is also the holding pen for slaves sold by
Maximus Maximus.  The slave shop MUST be numbered 1 LESS than this room.
The slaves MUST be marked SENTINEL.

Exits.Description: via Vestia
via phobia by Jupiter

Rooms.Name: Slave Shop
Rooms.Description:
This dusty little room off the via Phobia is where captives from
Rome's glorious wars are sold.  If you need someone to comb your hair
for you, teach your children, build your home or simply be your
companion and give his life for you, Maximus Maximus will be happy to
fill your requirements from his frequently replenished stock.  If you
have wandered in here by mistake, the street is straight out the door to
the north.
#GA large sign has been hung on the wall in front of your eyes.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign reads:

  Use 'List' to see the available slaves.
  To buy yourself a slave, use:
      'Buy <slave>'  or 'Buy <slave> <name>'

  Instructions for having slaves:

   You can order your slave with 
                  'order <slave> <instructions>' 
   If you have several slaves you may use 
                  'order followers <instructions>'
   If you abuse your slave, it will no longer regard you as its master.
 
  
 Regards,

 Maximus Maximus

Rooms.Name: Cold Storage for Slaves
Rooms.Description:
This is the holding pen for slaves sold by Maximus Maximus.  The
slave shop MUST be numbered 1 LESS than this room.  The slaves MUST be
marked SENTINEL.

Mobs.Name: adjudicator romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: An adjudicator is watching the games intently.
Mobs.Description:
The adjudicator is a retired gladiator.  Scars cover all exposed
parts of his body.  Although he is getting on in years, he remains
healthy and fit.

Mobs.Name: scorekeeper romemob
Mobs.LongDescription:
A scorekeeper places another marker on the stone as the horses pass the
turning point.
Mobs.Description:
The scorekeeper is a young man of about twenty-five years of age who is
very intently watching the race.  As the horses past the easternmost
point of the racetrack, he places another marker up where everyone can
see it.  After seven laps, the race is done.

Mobs.Name: tribune romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Representing the poorest of Romans, the tribune fights for their rights.
Mobs.Description:
A man of medium height with blond hair, green eyes, and a very white
toga worn over a deep blue tunic, the tribune has an honest face.  This,
you think, is a man you would trust.  Too bad you are about to stab him
in the back.

Mobs.Name: spectator fan romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A spectator is filthy, half drunk and screaming his head off.
Mobs.Description:
The spectator loves the blood and gore and death of the games.  He says
it's a chance for the gladiators to show their bravery and to die the
glorious death of combat.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote screams "Kill!!!!" at the top of his lungs.

Mobs.Name: patrician romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A patrician looks down at you from dark gray eyes.
Mobs.Description:
The patrician is dressed in fine clothes and jewelry and has a very
snobbish attitude.  While he is getting old and his hair and beard
are streaked with gray, he is by no means an easy target.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 em refuses to notice your unworthy presence.

Mobs.Name: slave romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A slave busies herself with small tasks, hoping not to be noticed.
Mobs.Description:
This very pretty young woman was captured when the Roman legions
subjugated her land.  She is quiet, dark, with brown hair and eyes and
very dark skin.  She is hoping to buy her freedom some day, and has
been looking about for business opportunities that won't take time from
her work.

Mobs.Name: gladiator romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: There is a gladiator standing here.
Mobs.Description:
This well muscled man is very heavily armored and armed to the
teeth.  He lives for combat, and has become a "star" of the arena.  He
has bribed the games' patron to match him up always with someone that
he can kill, but someone who will show off his skill.  He grows rich
with gifts from admiring fans.

Mobs.Name: driver romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The chariot driver eyes you as if wondering how fast you can run.
Mobs.Description:
You see a very slight and small individual whose whole life is
centered around nothing but horses and speed.  His only goal in life at
the moment is to get to the end of the track before anyone else.  If
that means trampling you into the dust, that is but a small price to
pay.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote yells, "Hey! You! Get outta da way!"
;%5 emote yells, "Hey! Meatballs for brains! You wanna get yourself
killed??"

Mobs.Name: coach trainer romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: There is a coach standing here, going over last minute strategy.
Mobs.Description:
A lot of gold rides on the outcome of each race.  As long as yours is
the first chariot over the finish line, it doesn't matter if you are in
it.  The coach talks to the charioteers about how to scream around the
bend on one wheel, how to get the most out of their horses, but not
about how to stay alive in the circus.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote eyes you suspiciously, sure you are trying to steal his
strategy.

Mobs.Name: healer romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The healer gives you wine to dull the pain.  This is gonna hurt!
Mobs.Description:
This young man is still learning about healing.  He has studied at the
temple of Aesculpius, but was not one of the brighter students.  He
seems to have a large number of very sharp instruments on him, which
does not reassure you.

Mobs.Name: herbalist romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful young woman carries herbs to help the healer.
Mobs.Description:
The herbalist is a very beautiful young woman who is about 22 years
old.  She  has deep brown eyes and shoulder-length chestnut hair.
Her body is perfectly proportioned and she stands about 5' 5" tall.

Mobs.Name: shopkeeper romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Titus's shopkeeper is minding the store while he is away.
Mobs.Description:
The shopkeeper is an older man in his middle to late fifties and
looks like he enjoys the quiet life.  There is a long scar running
from the edge of his mouth to his right ear, making it look like he
is always smiling.

Mobs.Name: peddler romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A poor peddler is trying to support his meager existence.
Mobs.Description:
The small, dirty man doesn't look very healthy.  He lives life on the
street.  He does get an occasional bath in the public baths and always
lines up for the entertainments on "public day" at the circus and the
Colosseum, but mostly you will see him wandering around, selling his
oranges, apples and hot chestnuts.

Mobs.Name: page romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A page stands here, waiting to run an errand.
Mobs.Description:
You see a young boy who looks very strong and very fast.  He has the
look of a scholar about him.

Mobs.Name: plaintiff romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The plaintiff works hard to prove his case.
Mobs.Description:
The son of a very wealthy senator, the plaintiff has accused the
defendant of not returning some very expensive jewelry to him after they
were no longer lovers.

Mobs.Name: master romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A ticket master is looking at you expectantly.
Mobs.Description:
This ticket master expects you to spend 1 gold coin to buy a ticket so
that you can enter the entertainment.  I would not attack him if I were
you!  You would most assuredly die.

Mobs.Name: vendor romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A street vendor sells overpriced sausages and wine.
Mobs.Description:
The vendor is a scruffy looking man who isn't afraid of a fight.  His
sausages are rather stringy, but filling, and the wine is sweetly
intoxicating.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 yell "Sausages! Hot and spicy! Get your sausages while they last!"

Mobs.Name: citizen romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A citizen of Rome, well wrapped in his toga, goes about his business.
Mobs.Description:
At the top of the social heap, this citizen is healthy and in great
physical shape.  As you are NOT a citizen, he ignores you as a
non-person.

Mobs.Name: gateguard guard romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A gateguard stands here, tending the gate.
Mobs.Description:
Clad in light armor, the gateguard makes sure only the right people are
allowed into Rome.  He also strictly enforces the "no cart" policy.
The streets have become so congested that no carts are allowed within
the city walls until after sunset.

Mobs.Name: soldier romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A soldier on leave is walking around looking for entertainment.
Mobs.Description:
You see a member of one of the republic's elite legions.  He looks
VERY strong.  You have this vague feeling that his entertainment
isn't going to be a very wholesome activity.

Mobs.Name: soldier roman romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The soldier trains hard, preparing for the summer campaigns.
Mobs.Description:
A short, strong young man with deep brown hair and twinkling green eyes,
he is quite serious about his training.  When his century goes to war,
he will be required to carry heavy packs on long marches, then build the
camp at the end of a long day.  He will fight valiantly or be killed by
his own commander.

Mobs.Name: guard bodyguard romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The bodyguard stands ready to die for the praetor, if necessary.
Mobs.Description:
The bodyguard is dressed in the finest of armor and wields only the
deadliest  of weapons.  He is very strong and would put up one hell
of a fight.  He has been trained to be suspicious of all but the most
innocent visitors, and likely to take offense of anyone with less
than pure intentions.

Mobs.Name: judge justice romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The judge takes his time consulting a lengthy scroll on law.
Mobs.Description:
Neatly trimmed gray hair surrounds a weathered and not-too-wise looking
face.  The judge bought his position in return for a hefty donation to
the city treasury, and he will be well-remunerated for his work by the
cases brought before him.

Mobs.Name: master scheduler romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The master scheduler keeps careful track of the trial schedule.
Mobs.Description:
A studious, elderly man of Greek origin, the master scheduler has
responsibilities to keep detailed records of court cases.  He does not
like to be disturbed when he is working.

Mobs.Name: slimeball slime ball green romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A green ball of slime is hanging over you, oozing downward.
Mobs.Description:
There is a green ball of slime oozing from the coating on the
walls.  It appears to have a life of its own, and it appears NOT to
like intruders.

Mobs.Name: Frobozz romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: FrobozZ the wizard mutters to herself as she perfects a new spell.
Mobs.Description:
Well, she's gone through a lot of dumb apprentices, and she's 
damned cranky.  Her knowledge of magic, both offensive and
defensive, is as legendary as her fashion sense, however.  You 
think you would be really stylin' in her robe.  I don't think 
she'd just *give* it to you, however.

Mobs.Name: senator romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The senator strides about, looking important.
Mobs.Description:
Well, of course, he IS important.  A man in his early 40s, he will tell
you he is in the prime of his life.  He rises early every morning to
order his household, then heads off to the office.  Afternoons are
devoted to indulgences and socializing at the baths, then the evenings
are entertaining with (important) friends.

Mobs.Name: bailiff romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The bailiff keeps order in the courtroom.
Mobs.Description:
Although he's not a very important man in social ranks, the bailiff is
very strong ... massively strong, actually ... and not at all afraid to
use his strength to subdue unruly spectators or others who disrupt the
orderly proceedings in this courtroom.

Mobs.Name: defendant romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The defendant pleads her case without much hope.
Mobs.Description:
During her lengthy love affair with the unprincipled son of a wealthy
senator, he gave her many valuable pieces of jewelry, as is the custom.
Now, having found another lover, he wants the expensive items returned.

Mobs.Name: jupiter romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Jupiter, King of the Gods, smiles benignly at his worshipers.
Mobs.Description:
He is the strongest of the Gods, and certainly no easy mark!  His
powers transcend the plane of the physical, and could easily kill an
unprepared mortal.  Yes, even you.

Mobs.Name: Venus romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Venus, the Goddess of Love and Beauty, ignores your unworthy presence.
Mobs.Description:
The most beautiful woman you have ever seen stands before you.
Actually, she towers over you.  Perfectly proportioned, yet at 10'
(over 3m) tall, she is also the largest woman you have ever seen.  And
perhaps the strongest.

Mobs.Name: Mars romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Mars, the God of War and State, is resting here.
Mobs.Description:
Husband to Venus and father of Rhea Silvia, mother of the founders of
Rome, Mars watches over this training field for Rome's soldiers, and he
accepts frequent tribute from them.

Mobs.Name: Mercury romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Mercury, looks out at you slyly from under his wrinkled brow.
Mobs.Description:
God of tradesmen and thieves, and Jupiter's messenger, Mercury's priests
and priestesses have grown quite wealthy on the tithes of roman
businessmen and traders.  Once a year on the 12th of August a portion of
this wealth is returned to the citizens in the form of a banquet.

Mobs.Name: shopkeeper romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Frobozz's shopkeeper is here, minding the store.
Mobs.Description:
The shopkeeper is an older man in his middle to late fifties and
looks like he enjoys the quiet life.  There is a long scar running
from the edge of his mouth to his right ear, making it look like he
is always smiling.

Mobs.Name: lion romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The scrawny tawny lion yawns, letting you see his sharp teeth.
Mobs.Description:
Oooh!  The breath on this lion is enough to kill you!  He looks like he
hasn't eaten in days.  His claws are still nice and sharp, though, and I
bet he has all those great feline skills.

Mobs.Name: grocer romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A grocer stands at the counter with a slightly impatient look.
Mobs.Description:
A tall grocer, who moves two 200 pounds bag of flour around on his
shoulders.

Mobs.Name: gardener romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The gardener glares at you as you tromp through his flower bed.
Mobs.Description:
A tall, lean, fit slave with callused hands and skin brown from
countless hours in the Roman sunlight, the gardener enjoys his work.
Tread lightly and watch your step, for if you hurt his plants you'll
have to answer to him!

Mobs.Name: fuller romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The fuller stares at your filthy tunic. Do you think he's a magician?
Mobs.Description:
Appearances are important to those who aspire to high political
office in Rome.  And all Roman citizens do.  A toga should be
pristine, without a stain.  The men who wear them should look young,
athletic, tanned and healthy.  The fuller's job is to clean togas and
other garments to maintain that image, but it's a pretty hard job
with no soap!

Mobs.Name: Norseman guards romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The tall fair Norseman stares stonily at you.
Mobs.Description:
Tall, brawny and very fierce, this Norseman came to pillage and
decided to stay and work.  He is paid a hefty fee by the jeweler to
stand at the entrance to the store and frighten would-be thieves.
His size alone is a major deterrent to crime!

Mobs.Name: functionary worker workers one romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: One of many hundreds of government workers stands before you.
Mobs.Description:
A busy little man, the functionary has a small wiry body and an air
of constant nervous energy.  His main joy in life is found in getting
in your face, and he is liable to call out the city guards if you
give him any lip!

Mobs.Name: praetor petyus romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Praetor Petyus drops the white flag to start the races.
Mobs.Description:
I wouldn't bother the Praetor at the moment.  He's very busy with
matters of state, and he is a very important man.  The Praetor is, of
course, tanned and fit, and well trained in martial arts.

Mobs.Name: Bacchus romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The god of wine, song and fertility invites you to party on with him.
Mobs.Description:
Bacchus is large, as befits a god, with an aura of sensuality about
him.  His wide forehead slopes to a long straight nose separating two
large gray eyes.  His mouth is full, curved, sensuous.  You have the
sense that this god enjoys all that he does.

Mobs.Name: Vulcan romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Vulcan wields his enormously heavy hammer as if it were a feather.
Mobs.Description:
Muscles hard as the iron at his forge, skin gleaming with a light sheen
of perspiration, Vulcan looks at you, mortal, indulgently.  A god of
incredible strength, he knows he has little to fear from a fight with
such as you.

Mobs.Name: advisor romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The finance advisor smiles cannily at you, easily estimating your worth.
Mobs.Description:
The investment advisor is a tall, elegant man, dressed in a pristine
white toga.  He is well tanned, virile, fit, the very image of the Roman
ideal.  He invites you to leave your money with him, where it will be
safely invested for you.

Mobs.Name: fireman romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The many Roman fires keep the fireman always running for water.
Mobs.Description:
The hot sun bakes the wooden structures that make up Rome's office
buildings and apartments, drying them as if in a kiln.  Cooking fires
and heating fires frequently throw sparks, easily igniting the building,
and the fireman is off to work again.  He is necessarily strong, and has
many scars from burns.

Mobs.Name: drinius romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Drinius has found a comfy spot to read his favorite scrolls.
Mobs.Description:
A student of everything, master of nothing in particular, Drinius was
the despair of his fond parents.  "Why do you always have your nose
buried in a scroll, Drinius?  Why aren't you out there conquering new
territory for Rome or something?"  But Drinius ignores them and goes his
own way.

Mobs.Name: Mattias trainer gladiator romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Mattias will charge you an arm and a leg to train you.
Mobs.Description:
After all, you will probably lose them anyway in the arena.  Actually,
this retired gladiator doesn't trade in limbs, but he will take your
gold to teach you how to fight bravely in the arena and, perhaps, to win
and live to fight another day.

Mobs.Name: rat romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The sewer rat sniffs at the odd smells entering her home.
Mobs.Description:
Long wiry whiskers twitching in disgust at the sights and sounds and
smells that humans bring to her sewer, the rat scurries about her
business.  She is a very LARGE rat, and looks like she might like to
take a bite out of you!

Mobs.Name: actor romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The actor provides pleasure to the Romans, and therefore is a star.
Mobs.Description:
Greatly admired and rewarded for his acting, the actor was able to buy
his freedom from his benefactor, who had him trained.  He wears heavy
masks and very stylized clothing to act in the melodramas and farces at
the theater.

Mobs.Name: stagehand romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Cursing quietly, the stagehand moves the heavy props into place.
Mobs.Description:
The stage props keep getting more and more elaborate every year, as the
theater vies for popularity with the more bloody Colosseum and the
racetrack.  Backdrops, heavy curtains, traps in the stage and all kinds
of gadgetry are managed by the few overworked stagehands.

Mobs.Name: athlete romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The athlete is stretching his body, preparing for exercise.
Mobs.Description:
Sharing the training fields with the soldiers, the athlete prepares for
a long run.  He will combine some running with some muscle building
activities designed to keep him fit.

Mobs.Name: bather man romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The old man sits in the steam, moist heat invading his joints.
Mobs.Description:
Coming to the baths, sharing war stories with his cronies are two
pleasures left in the life of this old soldier.  You can see his body
covered with scars, and wonder at the strength of spirit that has kept
him alive.  He is not tall, but very sturdily built, a man of great
stamina.

Mobs.Name: moorish soldier romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The moorish soldier straps on his gear, preparing for battle.
Mobs.Description:
As Rome has extended her frontiers, men and women of all types have been
brought to the city to serve.  In time they may earn their freedom, and
their children may become citizens.  This Moor is earning a good salary
in the Roman army.

Mobs.Name: cloakroom attendant romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The cloakroom attendant will store your garments while you bathe.
Mobs.Description:
A city-owned slave, this one has found an easy job.  He will not guard
your things, however he will help you remove them and fold them neatly
for you.  He is young and comely and undoubtedly has other duties than
folding togas and tunics.

Mobs.Name: trainee gladiator romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The trainee swings his sword clumsily, tripping over his own feet.
Mobs.Description:
Wealth or early death await this trainee in the arena.  Well, an early
death for this one if he doesn't learn to manage his sword better!  He
is poor, and has nothing except a lifetime of poverty to lose.  With
training there is hope he may win the gladiator's crown.

Mobs.Name: priest romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Being a priest is a political honor as well as a religious one.
Mobs.Description:
Serving the gods can be rewarding politically as well as financially.
The worshipers sacrifice gifts, and the priest gracefully accepts them
in the name of the god, of course.

Mobs.Name: priestess romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The priestess goes about her duties with sure, efficient movements.
Mobs.Description:
The priestess is a powerful woman in the prime of her life.  She is tall
and strong, and her skin, her hair and her eyes all glow with her
health.  She has been dedicated to the service of the god since early
adolescence, and clearly it suits her.

Mobs.Name: martyr romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The martyr bravely awaits her fate, knowing in her heart she is right.
Mobs.Description:
She could have worshipped her own gods as well as the Roman ones, but
she refused.  She has been sentenced to death in the arena.  A
beautiful, passionate young woman with chestnut hair and green eyes,
she will soon be torn to ribbons by a wild beast.

Mobs.Name: vestal virgin romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Dedicated to goddess Vesta, the virgin keeps the hearth fire burning.
Mobs.Description:
It's a career!  and a somewhat dubious honor for a noble woman to be
chosen to serve the goddess (and the republic) by keeping the fire
burning in the forum.  One of six women, she will serve for 30 years.
She will never marry.

Mobs.Name: retiarius gladiator romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The retiarian gladiator fights in little more than a loincloth.
Mobs.Description:
With little more than a loincloth and sandals for armor, and a net and
trident for weaponry, the retiarius has little hope of killing his
opponent.  He is hoping to be matched against someone who is weighed
down with heavy armor.

Mobs.Name: samnite gladiator romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The Samnite gladiator is well protected behind heavy armor.
Mobs.Description:
Well polished body armor sparkles in the light, reflecting you in all
your dirt and fear.  The Samnite carries a tall oblong shield, and
wears a metal helmet with a gruesome face mask to frighten you.  It
works.

Mobs.Name: murmillo gladiator romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The Murmillo gladiator snarls at you from beneath his heavy faceplate.
Mobs.Description:
The Murmillo gladiator is a man of average height.  He carries a tall,
square shield with a strange design in red and black.  He is well
armored, covered ankle to mid thigh in bronze, and with a helmet that
covers the lower half of his face.

Mobs.Name: thracian gladiator romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Carrying a light round shield, the Thracian gladiator is quite agile.
Mobs.Description:
The Thracian gladiator wears light but strong leather armor, his sword
arm protected with leather wrappings.  He carries a small round shield
and wears no leg armor.  He easily dodges blows and slips quickly
behind your guard to attack.

Mobs.Name: consul xelfking romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: As he walks, the Consul's white toga swirls about him like a cape.
Mobs.Description:
This consul radiates an aura of goodness.  From the tips of his
slightly pointed ears to the tips of his toes in his comfortable
leather sandals, you sense that finally you have found a man you can
trust.  His features are elfin, his body slender and not overly tall,
but there is still a sense of inner strength about him that you cannot
help but admire.

Mobs.Name: marcus lawyer romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The famous lawyer, Marcus Wallgrenus, slyly sizes you up.
Mobs.Description:
This citizen is no dummy!  He knows how to move up in the Roman world.
He is an excellent advocate, willing to do what it takes to win each
case and canny enough to know what that is.

Mobs.Name: faun romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A strange being, part goat, part man and GLOWING, dances in the gardens.
Mobs.Description:
A freak of nature or a god?  Clearly a free spirit, and clearly happy in
the garden.  He is about your height, but has massive shoulder and arm
muscles and apparently small horns on his head.

Mobs.Name: plebeian romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The plebeians toga is ragged and threadbare, but he is still proud.
Mobs.Description:
Still proud of his citizenship despite his poverty, the plebeian is ever
on the look out for ways to earn a little more gold.  Thick eyebrows
meet over a long, slightly crooked nose.  His deep tan make his teeth a
startling white when he smiles, which he does often.

Mobs.Name: augurer romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The augurer neatly slits the sacrificial beast from neck to tail.
Mobs.Description:
A small, thin, frail man with gray hair that extends past his waist, the
augurer is a man of mystery.  One of sixteen prophets in Rome, and one
of the most powerful men of Rome, the augurer advises the political
elite on every move they make.

Mobs.Name: Albertus Al ATM romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Albertus Tellus Maximus will cheerfully keep your money for you.
Mobs.Description:
The banker pats his belly and smiles benignly at you.  He is a truly
immense man, and there are rumors he has ties with the Family.  He will
take your money and invest it wisely, then give it back to you when you
need it, minus a small fee, of course.

Mobs.Name: equite romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: This equite may not be a social leader, but he is quite wealthy.
Mobs.Description:
Scorned by more patrician fellow citizens for his business dealings,
this equite has the last laugh as he watches them go into debt as his
wealth builds.  He is very tall and massively built, leading one to
believe there might be some minotaur ancestry in his bloodline.

Mobs.Name: woman shopworker romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The woman works in a shop by day, then cares for her family at night.
Mobs.Description:
A life of poverty is a life of hard work.  This small, dark woman looks
old for her years.  Her fingers are callused from work, and her back is
bent.  She has great strength in her wiry frame, but it is severely
tested.

Mobs.Name: carpenter romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The carpenter works long hours in the summer, but he is well paid.
Mobs.Description:
Never out of work in a city where politicians vie for public favor with
their building programs, this carpenter is hoping to move to better
quarters soon.  He is a tall, dark haired man of about 30 with a deep
tan from his life out of doors.

Mobs.Name: guest romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The dinner guest reclines lazily on the sofa, gesturing for more food.
Mobs.Description:
Elegantly coiffed, elegantly dressed, the guest is seated on an elegant
chaise and served elegant food.  Only rigorous training in the field of
Mars or at the gymnasium has enabled her to keep her well-proportionned
body.

Mobs.Name: roman woman romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The woman nods her head in your direction as she steps out of your way.
Mobs.Description:
At the bottom of the social heap, this woman shares space at
entertainments with the slaves knowing they may one day earn their
freedom, but she never will.  She longs for the freedom that wealth and
widowhood might bring, but realizes it is not to be her lot.

Mobs.Name: farmer romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The farmer brings produce left from the Faire to sell in Rome.
Mobs.Description:
He had a most profitable week while the Faire was in progress.  It was a
safe celebration and all the fairegoers seemed hungry, so he was able to
sell lots of his produce, but there is still some left to sell to the
greengrocer in town.

Mobs.Name: general romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The Roman general contemplates the celebrations of his victories.
Mobs.Description:
Wearing the laurel wreath of the successful Roman general, Fobos
Maximilius follows his successful army back to Rome.  They bring with
them treasures from the mighty civilizations and barbaric tribes they
have conquered.  The general ponders the effect his triumph may have on
his political career.  Perhaps he should stage a coup.

Mobs.Name: standard bearer roman soldier standard-bearer romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Glad to be back home, the standard-bearer slowly lowers the standard.
Mobs.Description:
A deep tan born of countless summers spent conquering new territory
contrasts sharply with the ice blue eyes and blond hair bleached almost
white by the sun.  The son of a slave turned freedman, this citizen's
Nordic heritage is very clear both in his coloring as well as his
fierceness in battle.

Mobs.Name: slave Gaul gallic captive romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The Gallic captive, now a slave to the Romans, glares haughtily at you.
Mobs.Description:
He was a great and fierce fighter, but he was captured and now will be
a great and proud slave.  His body still retains the remnants of blue
paint, which evidently was not enough to frighten off the Roman armies.
His amulet of herbs and unmentionables, worn about his neck, were also
not enough to protect him from capture.

Mobs.Name: roman warrior romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The mighty minotaur Roman warrior needs no helmet as his horns suffice.
Mobs.Description:
Roman citizens come in all shapes and sizes.  The minotaur's grandsire
was captured during an early raid on Crete.  He did well as a slave,
earning great quantities of gold as a favored charioteer (of the leek,
or green team).  He was freed, and his son and grandson thereby were
able to be citizens.

Mobs.Name: warrior elephant roman romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The huge elephant stomps along, grinding the dirt to dust.
Mobs.Description:
The pachyderm packs a whallop with her trunk, although she has not been
used for fighting.  Originally brought over from Africa by Hannibal,
who wanted to "surprise" the Romans one winter, these Romans are
delighted to bring them back as a prize to Rome.  They can carry
literally tons of treasure brought back from the wars.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 yawn;%5 emote rears back, preparing to STOMP you.

Mobs.Name: ratman roman warrior soldier ratsoldier romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The Ratman Ratsoldier looks fierce despite his long twitching tail.
Mobs.Description:
As long as you are a land owning citizen, you may sign up for a 20 year
stretch in the Roman army.  Although it is a hard life (especially for
a rat), the promise of glory and a regular salary are hard to resist.

Mobs.Name: halfling roman soldier romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The halfling looks small, but his heart is as brave as any Roman's.
Mobs.Description:
This halfling is small and far from the land of his grandparent's birth,
but he is a Roman citizen-soldier and very proud of it.  His parents,
captured in a raid, were able to buy their freedom from their small
tobacco shop.

Mobs.Name: gnome roman soldier romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The gnomish soldier is on holiday, looking for entertainment.
Mobs.Description:
This gnome was something of a washout in terms of carrying around 3 days
worth of equipment on his back, but he is a positive genius when it
comes to building bridges and designing campsites.  He is small and
getting a trifle old for the life of a soldier.

Mobs.Name: gnome old cloth merchant romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The old gnome leads a donkey laden with bolts of wool.
Mobs.Description:
Bringing heavy bolts of wool woven from Stanneg sheep, the cloth
merchant hopes to trade for some fairy cloth, should he be lucky enough
to discover the fairy home.

Mobs.Name: tinker romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The tinker easily carries his huge pack on his massive back.
Mobs.Description:
"Wandering from village to village, that's the life for me!"  A man of
enormous strength and cleverness, the tinker carries the tools of his
trade on his back.  Quick to fix, that's the tinker.

Mobs.Name: worshiper romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The worshiper prays his sacrifice will not go unheeded.
Mobs.Description:
The worshiper has saved all year to purchase the oxen to bring to
sacrifice to his god.  It has meant doing without, but he is used to
that.  If the god answers his prayer, he won't have to do without much
longer.

Mobs.Name: worshiper romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Bacchus' worshiper is long lost to the pleasures of wine, song and love.
Mobs.Description:
For this young woman, worship of the god Bacchus is like a continual
round of pleasure.  Her head in a drug and wine induced fog, she dances
for the god and the other worshipers, lost to the world around her.

Mobs.Name: high priest romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The high priest sacrifices the animal at the altar.
Mobs.Description:
The high priest is a patrician, a wealthy and noble Roman who has been
elected to this extremely important office.  If he cannot convince the
god to grant the people's wishes, all of Rome will suffer.

Mobs.Name: slave romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The slave hastens about his task.
Mobs.Description:
Brought here from Greece, this slave is unlikely to have to work very
hard.  He will most likely soon be employed as a tutor or scribe.  The
Romans have a healthy awe of Roman learning.

Mobs.Name: roman soldier romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The Roman soldier fought hard to win new land for Rome.
Mobs.Description:
Roman soldiers have earned enough for the republic in their many
campaigns of conquest that Roman citizens no longer must pay heavy
taxes or work as slaves due to their poverty.  This soldier was proud to
carry back part of the bounty of war, although the chest was quite
heavy.

Mobs.Name: wolf victim romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The shaggy gray wolf lifts his massive head as you enter his small den.
Mobs.Description:
Brought back from the far north by a minion of the Maximus clan, the
wolf wearies of his long waits in this airless hole.  The only
unfiltered light he has seen is when he has been released to hunt in the
arena.

Mobs.Name: panther victim romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The sleek black panther paces restlessly in his small cage.
Mobs.Description:
Brought back from a campaign 3 months ago, the panther has subsisted on
a steady diet of adventurers and gladiators.  He looks at you, bored, as
if to say, "Why couldn't they at least send someone who would be a
challenge?

Mobs.Name: bear victim romemob
Mobs.ShortDescription: the huge and very furry bear
Mobs.LongDescription: Looking like a big teddybear with teeth, the bear is ready to fight.
Mobs.Description:
One mighty swipe of his paw could easily knock you flat.  The long sharp
claws would rake the skin right off your body, leaving the meat and
bones there for him to munch on.

Mobs.Name: minotaur victim romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The minotaur lowers his head, ready to spear you with long sharp horns.
Mobs.Description:
Brought back from Minos, this minotaur is HUGE, sentient, intelligent,
and just plain mean.  He is a favorite of the Roman crowds, because
there is always a lot of blood and gore when the minotaurs are brought
out.

Mobs.Name: tiger victim romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The tigers' large black and gold stripes have a dizzying effect.
Mobs.Description:
The tiger rests lazily on the dirt floor of his cage.  Don't make the
mistake of thinking he is asleep.  Under the smooth glossy fur you can
see rippling muscles, and you know if he decides to *pounce* on you, you
are history.

Mobs.Name: prisoner victim romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The prisoner looks sadly around her cell, knowing she is about to die.
Mobs.Description:
She will not be much of a challenge for the gladiators, since she is so
weak from hunger and lack of sleep.  She spilled some red wine on the
white toga of a very important guest of the Maximus clan, and has been
sent here as an example to the other servants.

Mobs.Name: jeweler romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The jeweler eyes you appraisingly.
Mobs.Description:
Marius is a small, hefty freedman, a former slave to Homerus Maximus,
who is now his patrone.  Marius has an excellent eye for jewels and
knows what people will buy.  Naturally, he makes small "gifts" of his
best selections to his patrone.

%%4 say How about a little sparkle for the love of your life?
;%3 say YOU've got a friend in the diamond business!
;%3 emote smiles a particularly oily smile.

Mobs.Name: Julius Maximus romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: An aging senator, the head of the clan Maximus, Julius remains fit.
Mobs.Description:
Julius is a man of many years, but he has taken great care to remain fit
and youthful in appearance.  He owes his full head of hair to great
genes, but the deep brown color is from a substance purchased for him
from a small shop in town, a shop that he owns.

Mobs.Name: Gluteus Maximus
Mobs.LongDescription: Gluteus Maximus frowns as you intrude on his space.
Mobs.Description:
Gluteus has a lot wagered on this race, and doesn't take kindly to
intruders.  He is a MASSIVE man of truly colossal proportions.  Even his
tunic and toga can't disguise the beefiness of the form beneath.

Mobs.Name: Augustus Maximus romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Augustus cheers loudly for the leeks, as the chariots race past his box.
Mobs.Description:
The youngest of the male adults in the Maximus clan, Augustus is
probably the most successful.  He is good natured, friendly, active, and
an astute businessman.  Like the rest of his clans, he makes frequent
trips to the field of Mars and the baths to remain fit and healthy.  He
would be a challenging opponent!

Mobs.Name: Gaius hotfood shopkeeper romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Face glowing with sweat, Gaius asks, "What can I get for you?"
Mobs.Description:
Since most people can't cook at home, Gaius does a good business
providing hot food.  He has several shops in different parts of Rome,
where he caters to different appetites.  It is always hot in his store,
but Gaius has become used to it.

%%5 emote wipes down the counter with a fairly clean rag.
;%5 emote accepts delivery of a shipment of elephant tails from the
arena.

Mobs.Name: Sulla image shopkeeper romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Sulla sells magic to enhance your image.
Mobs.Description:
Sulla purchases powders, potions and other items from alchemists and
priests of many sects and resells them to the wealthy.  His many
assistants will also perform various services for you, such as
hairdressing, hair softening, hair removal, hair coloring, massage, in
short, anything to enhance your beauty.  Sulla has many of his
assistants working at the more exclusive baths in town.

Mobs.Name: assistant romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Sulla's assistant will painlessly remove hair from your arms and legs.
Mobs.Description:
Using a mixture of bat's blood and hedgehog ashes, Sulla's assistant
will peel the hair from your arms and legs.  Roman men prefer to be
hairless, although generally they prefer this to be done in privacy.
Sulla is also skilled in using hot walnut shells to soften the hair, in
case you do not like arm stubble.

Mobs.Name: assistant romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The shopkeeper's assistant sweeps up the shop, trying to look busy.
Mobs.Description:
A young slave, learning the business, the assistant has learned it is
best to always at least appear to be busy.  The assistant is about 14,
the son of another of the shop owner's slaves.  He knows he is quite
lucky to have landed such an easy spot in life.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 emote grumbles under his breath.
;%5 emote mutters, "I always get stuck with the dirty work."

Mobs.Name: spectator fan romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A spectator is filthy, half drunk and screaming his head off.
Mobs.Description:
The spectator has a small fortune riding on the leeks losing today, but
he's so drunk and rowdy he's all but forgotten.  He's not a very tall
man, but very strong and very hairy, showing some of his undoubted
dwarven ancestry.

Mobs.Name: spectator fan romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A spectator is filthy, half drunk and screaming his head off.
Mobs.Description:
The spectator loves all the spectacle of the theater, which has gotten
very amusing now that it has some real competition in the form of the
arena in the north of town.

Mobs.Name: Drucilla woman roman romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Drucilla drowsily drifts off into dreamland, dreading dinner.
Mobs.Description:
Drucilla would rather be anywhere but entertaining boring dinner guests.
Her mind drifts off as she smiles and nods at them.  Where has she gone?
Drucilla the dreamy-eyed is tall and slender, with dark brown hair
fashionably styled in brown curls around her pale brown-eyed face.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 em looks up at you, startled out of her reverie.

Mobs.Name: patrician roman romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The patrician ignores you, his attention focused elsewhere.
Mobs.Description:
Unless you are another wealthy citizen or unless you are needed for some
task, or unless you get in his way, you do not exist for this wealthy,
toga-wearing citizen.  You are of less importance than the sandals on
his elegant feet.  Body hardened by hours spent on the Field of Mars,
the patrician will be a difficult opponent.

Mobs.Name: equite wealthy romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The equite looks about him with satisfaction, pleased at his success.
Mobs.Description:
Gradually moving up the social ladder, the equite has made quite a lot
of money off the Roman's love for the odd and unusual.  This helps him
hang out with the patricians.  Since he spends most of his time social
climbing and making money, he is not quite so fit as his patrician
"friends".
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote pats his paunch and smiles.

Mobs.Name: gateguard guard romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A gateguard stands here, tending the gate.
Mobs.Description:
Clad in light armor, the gateguard makes sure only the right people are
allowed into Rome.  He also strictly enforces the "no cart" policy.
The streets have become so congested that no carts are allowed within
the city walls until after sunset.

Mobs.Name: gateguard guard romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A gateguard stands here, tending the gate.
Mobs.Description:
Clad in light armor, the gateguard makes sure only the right people are
allowed into Rome.  He also strictly enforces the "no cart" policy.
The streets have become so congested that no carts are allowed within
the city walls until after sunset.

Mobs.Name: nymph romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: This nymph will tempt you into dishonor with her seductive beauty.
Mobs.Description:
Beautiful but deadly.  The nymph smiles seductively at you, inviting you
to follow her into joyful but mindless abandon.  Forever young, forever
beautiful, forever dangerous.

Mobs.Name: pan romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The curious looking man with goat horns and goat feet plays his pipes.
Mobs.Description:
Pan is looking for woodland nymphs, hoping to lure them to him with his
music.  He is always looking for them, but never accepted because he is
SO ugly.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote looks around for a nymph to chase.

Mobs.Name: woman wife romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The young Roman woman sits on the hard wooden benches, watching.
Mobs.Description:
Another non-person to the rest of the Romans, the young woman still
enjoys watching the entertainments, even though she must sit high up
against the back wall and on hard, splintery wooden benches.  Hers is a
hard life, and although she possesses a certain wiry strength, she will
not live long enough to give her husband more than a child or two.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote shrinks back, trying NOT to be noticed.

Mobs.Name: slave drunk romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The slave found some time off and went out to have a good time.
Mobs.Description:
Lucky to be the pampered slave of a very indulgent master, the young man
used to be even closer to his master and his master's friends.  Once he
started growing a beard, however, he was given errands to run and
speeches to scribe.  Much more boring work.

Mobs.Name: farmer romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The farmer has come into town from Stanneg, full of wonder at Rome.
Mobs.Description:
Although he has heard all his life about the marvels of the great city
of Rome, he has always believed them to be myths.  A cyclops raid on his
home burned down his crops and farmhouse, so he has taken his family to
Rome to seek his fortune.

;%5 say well I'll be the son of a blue-nosed donkey!  Will you look at
that!

Mobs.Name: helper romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The fuller's helper has slipped away from his work to enjoy the day.
Mobs.Description:
The fuller is at his country home today, so his helper closed up the
shop early and escaped to enjoy the day with his friends.  Hopefully, he
will not be caught!  He is a youth of 17, tall with dark hair and a long
straight nose that hints of his patrician ancestry.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote looks at your dirty clothes and snickers softly.

Mobs.Name: vendor romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The vendor sells hot roast chestnuts to warm your hands and belly.
Mobs.Description:
Every morning she buys chestnuts at the grocers and hot charcoal, then,
rain or shine, roasts chestnuts in the Forum.  She will wrap them in a
bit of paper or cloth she finds and give them to you to warm your hands,
your mouth and your belly.  The vendor is ageless, and you feel she may
have some tricks up the long loose sleeves of her tunic.
