%%1 yell Hot chestnuts! Get your charcoal-grilled chestnuts right
here!!

Mobs.Name: Antonius romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Shoulders stooped with age, the elderly man peers at a scroll.
Mobs.Description:
His eyesight going as are the rest of his faculties, still, Antonius the
Younger is a remarkable orator.  His grasp of Roman common law is
remarkable, and his name is well known throughout the courts.  For that
reason, his services are still much sought after and he can well afford
his luxurious office.

Mobs.Name: jason romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: #GJason is much more than a pretty piece of marble.#N
Mobs.Description:
Jason led the original Super Hero band.  One glance at his incredible
physique (and this clear white marble statue hides NOTHING), one peek
into his clever mind, and you can easily understand why so many Greek
Heroes followed him to Colchis.  Of course, stealing the golden fleece
back from the dragon might have had something to do with it as well.

Mobs.Name: Maximus romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Maximus Maximus chortles gleefully as another sucker enters his shop.
Mobs.Description:
A small, oily man of indeterminate age, you can sense that in another
lifetime Maximus might have sold used camels or snake oil cures.  There
is a wiry strength to his body and a look of confidence and
determination that makes you hesitate to attack him.

Mobs.Name: young Briton romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A young Briton was brought back from one of Rome's recent campaigns.
Mobs.Description:
Trainable!  This young man would be good for running errands.  If he is
brighter than he looks, he might make a good scribe.  Although he comes
just to the elbow of your average full-grown minotaur, he has reached
his full height, and the long walk back from his homeland has
strengthened him.

Mobs.Name: pedagogue greek teacher ped romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The pedagogue might be able to teach you to read.
Mobs.Description:
An expensive slave, much valued.  You will be the envy of all of your
friends if you buy this brilliant, cultured Greek pedagogue.  And, due
to some slight infirmities we are willing to sell him cheap!

Mobs.Name: druid witch woman romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: A witchy woman from Gaul casts some nasty spells on you.
Mobs.Description:
Don't let the blue skin put you off!  This wench will cast her evil
spells only on your enemies if you should buy her.  With the loose black
waves of hair floating behind her she may look a bit untidy, but she
will be a blessing in your retinue.

Mobs.Name: warrior fierce Hun romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: The battle-scarred blond warrior looks fierce.  Scary!
Mobs.Description:
Towering above you, this Hun was brought back from a land far to the
north of here inhabited mainly by Germanic tribes.  Such a deal! Already
trained in the arts of war, this warrior could make a bundle for you in
the arena.  Make an investment in your future with this warrior.

Mobs.Name: dresser female hairdresser slave romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: An elderly hairdresser would make a nice present for your sister.
Mobs.Description:
This woman is well trained in the arts of styling hair in the latest
fashion.  Roman clothing may not change much from year to year, but you
wouldn't want to go to that dinner party in last year's hairstyle!  This
little woman won't eat much, but she will be worth her weight in gold
coins.

Mobs.Name: architect builder romemob
Mobs.LongDescription: Slave to the joys of building, the roamin architect-builder works ceaselessly.
Mobs.Description:
Finally ready to build that little villa outside town?  Perhaps you had
something a bit grander in mind?  A fortress on top of a volcano?  A
small village inhabited by some of Rome's more unusual creatures?  Then
you've come to the right place.  Purchase this builder and ride his
dream!

Objects.Name: pickled frog lips jar glass
Objects.ShortDescription: a clear glass jar of pickled frog lips
Objects.Description: You can see pickled frog lips clearly through the glass of this jar.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These frog lips were "harvested" in a swamp infested with evil
creatures. It is said they possess great power when used in combination
with the right incantations and the right aspect of the moon.

Objects.Name: beer barrel
Objects.Description: A beer barrel has been left here.

Objects.Name: beer bottle
Objects.Description: A beer bottle has been left here.

Objects.Name: vodka bottle
Objects.Description: A transparent bottle is standing here.

Objects.Name: dagger
Objects.Description: A dagger with a long thin blade is here.

Objects.Name: sword small
Objects.Description: A small sword lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The small sword seems to have an inscription of some sort inscription...
It says: "May this sword be a good companion."

Objects.Name: sword long
Objects.Description: A long sword has been left here.

Objects.Name: club wooden
Objects.Description: A simple looking wooden club is here.

Objects.Name: flail large
Objects.Description: A large flail is here.

Objects.Name: torch
Objects.Description: A large torch.

Objects.Name: lantern
Objects.Description: A brass lantern is here.

Objects.Name: bag
Objects.Description: A small bag is here.

Objects.Name: atm teller bank machine
Objects.Description: An automatic teller machine has been installed in the wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is a small note on the machine which says:

To use, type "BALANCE", "WITHDRAW x", or "DEPOSIT x".  Please report any
strange occurrences to the bank manager.

Objects.Name: scroll identify
Objects.Description: A scroll has carelessly been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The scroll has a magic formula drawn upon it:
     ???
    ?   ?
       ?
      ?
      ?
      *

Objects.Name: potion yellow seeinvis
Objects.ShortDescription: a yellow potion of see invisible
Objects.Description: A small yellow potion has carelessly been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The potion has a small label 'Detect The Invisible'.

Objects.Name: scroll recall
Objects.Description: A scroll has carelessly been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The scroll has written a formulae of 'Word of Recall' upon it.

Objects.Name: wand invis
Objects.Description: A wand has carelessly been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wand is an old dark stick.  You notice a small symbol etched at the
base of the wand.  It looks like this:

     \ /
    - O -
     / \

Objects.Name: staff sleep
Objects.Description: A staff has carelessly been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The staff is made of old oak, and is around five feet long. It fits
perfectly into your hand. You notice a small symbol etched at the
base of the staff, it looks like:

  ZZZZZ
     Z
    Z
   Z
  ZZZZZ  z   z

Objects.Name: ring pewter romeobj
Objects.Description: A ring hammered out of pewter gleams softly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Soft gray pewter formed in a simple solid round band slides easily
around any finger, magically adjusting its size.  On the inside,
engraved very faintly, you see some words.
ad infinitum an jellitum

Objects.Name: bronze belt romeobj
Objects.Description: This bronze belt will probably be overlooked since it is invisible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Hammered from bronze by dwarven metalsmiths, this belt is adequate
protection for a new soldier.  Being invisible, it may lure an enemy to
strike where it appears the soldier is unprotected.  Very cunning.

Objects.Name: helmet roman combat romeobj
Objects.Description: A Roman combat helmet has been put aside for later.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The awkward looking bronze helmet has cheek guards which extend from ear
to mouth.  It is awkward and heavy and uncomfortable to wear, but the
wonderful crest of red feathers extending from the middle front back
makes it well worth the discomfort.

Objects.Name: bulla romeobj
Objects.Description: A boy's small amulet has been lost.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small pouch made of sheepskin contains magical herbs, charms and other
less identifiable ingredients that will help you grow up strong and
healthy.  By the time you are a man, of course, you won't need it any
longer!
^

Objects.Name: hairpin romeobj
Objects.Description: A beautifully jeweled hairpin is begging to be stolen.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Diamonds and sapphires alternate on this lovely, large hairpin, meant to
skewer some wealthy woman's hair to her lovely head.
^

Objects.Name: apple romeobj
Objects.Description: A delicious looking apple shines redly without being waxed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Fresh from one of the Elysium orchards, a bite into this apple leaves
you feeling enchanted.  It is crisp and juicy and sweet, and quite
filling.

Objects.Name: orange romeobj
Objects.Description: A sun-ripened orange has been left here for you to eat.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Well, you know what an orange looks like, don't you? This is a perfect
specimen of navel orange.  It is large, with a thick skin.  Inside is a
mild, sweet, juicy fruit that will help keep you from getting scurvy.

Objects.Name: sandals romeobj
Objects.Description: A pair of leather sandals is missing a pair of feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Plain brown sandals made from thick leather were hand cut and stitched
to fit your feet.  The leather was softened by a process you'd rather
not know about.  They are comfortable and afford a minor amount of
protection for your feet.  Very minor.

Objects.Name: sausage romeobj
Objects.Description: A sausage loaded with peppers and onions makes your stomach revolt.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A nice juicy sausage made of ferret meat is a favorite of Romans of all
classes, which is probably why you will see so few ferrets in Rome
today.

Objects.Name: bracelet silver gold romeobj
Objects.Description: Silver and gold spin in a never ending circle that will fit your wrist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Two thin circles of silver and gold twist together to form a perfect
circle.  The bracelet was made by the mighty Froboz for a young slave
who attracted him.  After many such gifts, the slave sold them all and
bought his freedom.  Fortunately for him, Froboz took it all very
philosophically.

Objects.Name: sapphire ring romeobj
Objects.Description: The blue of the #bsapphire#G is the same shade as an Elfking's eyes.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One of Marius's slaves has attached a large deep blue sapphire to a wide
band of gold to make this very expensive-looking ring.  It is a ring
favored by Roman priests for its protective qualities.

Objects.Name: pendant jade romeobj
Objects.Description: A beautiful jade pendant was brought back from the far provinces.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Dangling on a long gold chain is a large piece of deep green jade.
Drinius bought it from Marius the jeweler for his wife, Drucilla, as a
bride-present.  He had the jade inscribed for her to ward off great
winged creatures that he swears exist only in her (rather too vivid)
imagination.  The inscription?  That's a little too private to relate,
but perhaps she will show it to you someday and translate.

Objects.Name: tempered sword romeobj
Objects.Description: A nasty looking tempered sword makes a good weapon for a warrior.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This finely tempered sword must have been brought back from the future.
Why anyone in their right mind would want to wield it is beyond me.

Objects.Name: quenched sword romeobj
Objects.Description: A very bloody, but quenched, sword has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Having slaked its thirst (for blood) in the bodies of Rome's conquered,
this sword is thoroughly quenched.  Other than that it seems to be a
perfectly nice, utilitarian sword.  If you put the point on the ground,
the hilt would come about to your hip joint.  It is quite sharp, but a
little heavy.  It will do more damage if you can find some nice
enchanting wizard to make it glow.

Objects.Name: bracers moorish romeobj
Objects.Description: A pair of Moorish bracers has been dropped.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Worn by the fierce warriors from the provinces in the north coast of
Africa, these bracers are made of heavy leather with metal inlays.

Objects.Name: plate breast roman combat romeobj
Objects.Description: A piece of military combat plate has been stolen from some Roman.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Designed to protect your chest, this heavy metal plate covers you from
neck to navel, and bears the insignia of the City of Rome.  Designed to
cover you from neck to navel, it is a bit uncomfortable to wear, but not
nearly as uncomfortable as having your body split open by some barbarian
spear.
^

Objects.Name: boots combat romeobj
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of Roman combat boots
Objects.Description: A pair of combat boots have been abandoned by some Roman soldier.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Don't try to go dancing in these!  Thick, heavy, klutzy, metal-clad
leather boots provide wonderful protection for tender toes from the
stomps of combat and falling rocks on trails, but they don't do much to
make you graceful!

Objects.Name: thunderbolt romeobj
Objects.Description: Jupiter's Thunderbolt zzzzings into the ground at your feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Sizzling electric energy makes the thunderbolt glow with a light that
makes you afraid to touch it, afraid you will be burned.  There appears
to be no handle on the glowing yellow rod.  You can sense that this is
indeed a powerful weapon for a god to wield.

Objects.Name: loincloth red romeobj
Objects.Description: A deep red loincloth makes a soft pile of cloth on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Power seems woven into the very fabric of this loincloth, and you can
sense that this would be a very good thing for a warrior to wear.

Objects.Name: crystal necklace romeobj
Objects.Description: Sparkling crystals make a very bright necklace.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
According to legend this necklace once belonged to Venus.  Each facet of
each crystal reflected her unearthly beauty.

Objects.Name: winged sandals romeobj
Objects.Description: Mercury's winged sandals have landed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Very ordinary leather sandals except for the wings ... It's a little
hard to keep your balance while wearing these cause your center of
gravity is a ways up from your means of locomotion ...

Objects.Name: gray dark gray scroll romeobj
Objects.Description: Something has been written on dark gray parchment and rolled up.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Scrawled in a dark reddish brown on a dark gray scroll you see a magical
incantation.  At the end of the scroll is the single word Aesculpius.

Objects.Name: ornate scroll romeobj
Objects.Description: An ornate scroll has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Inscribed in dark gold on ancient parchment, the words seem meaningless
to you.  The scroll is fragile, crumbling in your hands, and unlikely to
survive more than one use.

Objects.Name: plain scroll romeobj
Objects.Description: A plain scroll is lying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Most of the scroll is in very high Latin and very incomprehensible to
you, however at the end there are some words written in a much lower
form of Latin.  You might understand these.
 
#w          astlay esortray - eciteray onnay elfsay #N

Objects.Name: bag herbs romeobj
Objects.Description: There is a small, sweet-smelling bag on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you peek inside this small pigskin pouch, you see some green and
brown herbs, ground to a powder.  They smell sweet yet pungent, and are
somehow soothing to your spirit.

Objects.Name: staff kodarta romeobj
Objects.Description: A Kodarta staff has been carelessly abandoned.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Serpents twining around each other in a spiral have been carved deeply
into this strong wooden staff.  The carving is very amateurish, however
the staff is still appealing, and incites in you a desire to hold it and
wave it about.

Objects.Name: wand prototype romeobj
Objects.Description: There is a prototype of a new magical wand lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Who knows what the great Froboz has been up to now?  This is a metal
wand, hammered in bronze, with a hollow core.  You can hear something
sloshing inside, but there doesn't appear to be any means of opening the
wand.

Objects.Name: blaze orange flask potion lotion romeobj
Objects.Description: There is a flask, containing a blaze orange lotion from Image Works.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The label on this strange little flask reads as follows:

#wTired of that hairy barbarian look?  Quaff this little lotion and
watch your worries disappear!#N

Objects.Name: ticket romeobj
Objects.Description:
An admission ticket marked with the word "Colosseum" has been discarded
here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small scrap of paper has been marked with the words "Admit One" and
"Colosseum".  It looks like an entrance ticket to entertainment in the
arena.  Use it to activate the entrance and then go in to find your
seat!

Objects.Name: vase flowerpot flower pot romeobj
Objects.Description: A very large pot filled with flowers enhances the doorway.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large earthenware pot painted with scenes of gods dancing in lush
gardens sits in front of an apartment doorway.  It has been planted with
lush flowers, but the dirt seems not to have been smoothed down, and you
can see a glint down in one corner.

Objects.Name: straw doormat mat romeobj
Objects.Description: A straw doormat, very bedraggled, lies in front of the door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A mat made of woven straw shows at least an attempt to keep the dirt
from this pathetic little apartment at the top of the building.  It has
seen better days, and for that matter will probably disintegrate into
dust quite soon.

The lintel stretches over top of the door, and seems like the perfect
hiding place for keys, etc.

Objects.Name: ticket romeobj
Objects.Description:
An admission ticket marked with the word "Circus" has been discarded
here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small scrap of paper has been marked with the words "Admit One" and
"Circus".  It looks like an entrance ticket to entertainment in the
arena.  Use it to activate the entrance and then go in to find your
seat!

Objects.Name: theater ticket romeobj
Objects.ShortDescription: a front-row seat ticket to the theater
Objects.Description:
An admission ticket marked with the word "Theater" has been discarded
here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small scrap of paper has been marked with the words "Admit One" and
"Theater".  It looks like an entrance ticket to entertainment in the
arena.  Use it to activate the entrance and then go in to find your
seat!

Objects.Name: ticket romeobj
Objects.Description: An admission ticket marked with the word "Balcony" has been discarded.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small scrap of paper has been marked with the words "Admit One" and
"Balcony".  It looks like an entrance ticket to entertainment in the
theater.  Use it to activate the stairs up and then go in to find your
seat!

Objects.Name: honeyed dormouse romeobj
Objects.Description: A delicious roast honeyed dormouse sits temptingly on a platter.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: Freshly cooked, slightly crispy, this delicacy makes your mouth water.

Objects.Name: veggies vegetables romeobj
Objects.Description: A small collection of veggies makes a colorful splash on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large collection of colorful vegetables fresh from the farms of
Stanneg.  These veggies will be good fresh or thrown in a pot with some
fresh ostrich tongue.

Objects.Name: burning wand flame romeobj
Objects.Description: Small jets of flame are shooting from this wand.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This small wand looks almost too hot to hold.  It is made of flame, and
liable to burn your hands if you try to grab it.  Still, it is likely to
burn others just as badly, so perhaps it would make a good weapon after
all.

Objects.Name: fountain wine nymphs satyrs satyr nymph romeobj
Objects.ShortDescription: a white marble fountain of wine
Objects.Description: Nymphs and satyrs chase each other merrily around the fountain's base.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large marble fountain features a carving of nymphs and satyrs chasing
each other around the large round base.  It is clear what would happen
should any of them ever be caught, and it is perhaps a lesson in wanting
what you can't have.  The fountain is filled with blood red wine,
spilling slowly from a vessel held by a rather athletic-looking pair in
the middle of the fountain.

Objects.Name: chestnuts romeobj
Objects.Description: Roasted over a charcoal fire, these chestnuts are delicious.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A handful of chestnuts have been roasted over a charcoal fire til their
shells are blackened and dry, split wide open.  They are filling and hot
and very satisfying.

Objects.Name: toga romeobj
Objects.ShortDescription: a clean white toga with a purple stripe
Objects.Description: A long purple stripe marks this toga as belonging to someone important.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The consul's toga marks him as a citizen and a person of importance.
Made of a circle of white cloth, it takes a while to learn to wrap it
about the body, and leaves you with a length of cloth hanging over one
arm.  Still, the prestige of being able to wear such a garment is
certainly worth any little inconvenience.

Objects.Name: flamingo tongues romeobj
Objects.ShortDescription: a plate of baked flamingo tongues
Objects.Description: A hundred tiny tongues lie quietly on this plate.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A delicacy affordable only to the most wealthy, this plate of flamingo
tongues is healthy nutrition, if a bit unappetizing to most.

Objects.Name: whip slave romeobj
Objects.Description: A good slave owner rarely needs to use this small slave whip.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It looks like, properly applied, it would hurt!  The whip is short, made
of a soft dark leather, with a loop at the thick end to hold and a long
fringe of leather strips at the other.  Designed to hurt without causing
too much damage, it is an effective tool for handling recalcitrant
slaves.
^

Objects.Name: collar slave romeobj
Objects.Description: A thick, wide, yet soft collar of leather has a large brass ring.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Thick, soft leather with a series of small brass buckles forms a collar
commonly used for captives.  A large brass ring is affixed to the
collar, providing a connection point for a chain by which the captive
may be led.  The collar's strength and width also provides some
protection to that vulnerable point on the captive's body.  Two of these
collars would provide a great deal of protection.

Objects.Name: truesight clear potion romeobj
Objects.Description: There is a beaker of truesight, lying discarded.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The label reads,
 
       #wSometimes clarity of vision is a curse, not a blessing.#N

Objects.Name: rusted key romeobj
Objects.Description: There is a rusted key here.

Objects.Name: double key
Objects.Description: A double sided key has been left.

Objects.Name: diamond key romeobj
Objects.Description: A diamond studded key is sitting on the ground.

Objects.Name: pearl key
Objects.ShortDescription: a key with a pearl handle
Objects.Description: A key with a pearl handle is sitting on the ground.
